title: New Library button in animation manager freezes Godot after repeated uses
body: ### Tested versions Latest 4.6 flatpak, the binary from godoengine.org, ~~and even while running the editor by building the solution in debug mode from within Rider. In Rider, I also noticed memory usage climbing after the freeze, but I don't know that it's related~~. This isn't a problem when built from source, even at 4.6. I noticed that I have a Godot native file browser in the source build. ### System information Godot v4.6.stable (89cea1439) - Freedesktop SDK 25.08 (Flatpak runtime) on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Ti (nvidia) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-12700K (20 threads) - 31.07 GiB memory ### Issue description I just want to say that this bug has been extremely difficult to pin down and reproduce. While I can reliably reproduce the bug using the animation library window, I believe this is related to similar freezes I've experienced all over the editor. The unifying element that I can see is the presence of a pop-up, whether that's a dialog box, a dropdown selector, or even just a tooltip. Godot will lock up when I open the 'New Library' dialog, enter some text, and then close the dialog with the cancel button. It can take a few minutes of repetition, but it does happen. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create a new, empty Godot project 2. Add an animation player 3. Go to the 'Animations' tab in the bottom dock; click on 'Animations' -> 'Manage Animations' 4. Click on '+ New Library' 5. Fill the text box with anything then close the dialog without saving 6. Repeat 4 & 5 until Godot locks up ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
